_note: Reference answers for the demo images, copied verbatim from each dataset's own annotations. Use these to sanity-check outputs -- but read demo/README.md first: some of these are NOT a pass/fail bar for a zero-shot model.

checkable.question: Is it a rural or an urban area?

not_a_target.question: What is the number of roads?
not_a_target.why: RSVQA counts are exhaustive object counts; a zero-shot VLM will not reproduce them. See README.

checkable.question: Is it a rural or an urban area?

not_a_target.question: What is the number of buildings?

01_single_image/vrsbench_P0003_0002.png.reference_caption: The aerial image from GoogleEarth features a group of large yellow buses lined up on the left side, and two small vehicles, one on the top-right and another large vehicle on the bottom-right side of the image. The buses are parked in a lot adjacent to a green area and a road running roughly north-south.

vqa.question: What color are the large vehicles seen in the image?
How many small vehicles are visible in the image?
Is there a vehicle located at the top-most position in the provided image?
What is the orientation of the road in the image?

referring.expression: The large yellow vehicle situated closest to the green area.
referring.raw_format: x1,y1,x2,y2 on a 0-100 grid -- NOT pixels
referring.contract_format: [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] in pixels, per PLAN.md 4.1
referring.why_this_matters: Both the scale AND the axis order differ. Skipping either conversion yields a meaningless IoU rather than an error -- this exact mismatch was caught before publishing rubric row 1d.

referring.expression: The large vehicle located at the bottom-left corner of the image.
The small dark-colored vehicle located at the top-right corner of the image.

02_change_pair.measured_how: fraction of pixels where the per-date semantic label differs (label1 != label2), computed over the two GT label PNGs shipped alongside
02_change_pair.baseline_to_beat: A degenerate 'everything changed' predictor scores precision equal to the GT change rate. Over the 30-pair scored subsample that floor is 0.1832 and the system scores 0.2492 -- 1.36x trivial. Real signal, but weak.
02_change_pair.note: The GT label PNGs are for your eyes only -- the system never sees them.

03_cross_modal.source: BigEarthNet v2.0, patch S2A_MSIL2A_20170613T101031_N9999_R022_T33UUP_61_39 (Austria, test split) + its co-registered S1 pair S1A_IW_GRDH_1SDV_20170613T165043_33UUP_61_39
03_cross_modal.optical_file: S2_optical_RGB_61_39.tif -- Sentinel-2 B04/B03/B02 stacked to 3 bands, resolves to modality 'optical'
03_cross_modal.sar_file: S1_SAR_VV_VH_61_39.tif -- Sentinel-1 VV/VH stacked to 2 bands, resolves to modality 'sar'
03_cross_modal.note: These two are the SAME 120x120 ground footprint on the SAME date, which is what makes the cross-modal comparison meaningful. Both stacks were built from the original per-band BigEarthNet tifs; band order matters (PLAN.md 4.5) and these are in the order benclip expects.
